description: Runs your backtest spec twice: once on the point-in-time universe (delisted companies included while they traded, the honest result) and once on only the names still trading today (what a backtest on a current ticker list does). Returns both stats and the inflation in CAGR and Sharpe that survivorship bias adds. Use universe 'top500'|'top1000'|'top3000' or a symbol list. Costs one backtest.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: survivorship_audit
title: Survivorship-bias audit
